purpose: TransitionPlan for the customer_order_drafts table. Short-lived checkout draft (15 min TTL) created at proceed-to-checkout.
businessRules: Returns a static TransitionPlan via transitionPlan() factory method.
Initial transition: fromVersions=[-1] to toVersion=0 (table creation + indexes).
Future schema changes are added as new transitions (fromVersions=[0] to toVersion=1, etc.) without modifying the existing transition.
Called by V1__Schema (initial setup) or a future VN__*.java migration for incremental changes.
MigrationRunner skips transitions whose fromVersions do not match the current DB version for this table.
